verdict.rationale: Sierra's Agent Studio docs confirm ingestion of Help Center content, FAQs, and policies as grounding knowledge (sierra-docs-7), and Ghostwriter can ingest SOPs/transcripts to build journeys (sierra-docs-9), but there is no evidence of ingesting past support tickets or internal wikis, nor confirmation that this happens without manual re-authoring. missing for 10: ticket history ingestion, internal wiki ingestion, explicit no-re-authoring workflow, independent verification of automated sync.
